verses.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ לִבְנֵי־קֹ֬רַח מַשְׂכִּֽיל׃
verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ. لِبَنِي قُورَحَ. قَصِيدَةٌ
verses.en: For the Leader; a Psalm of the sons of Korah. Maschil.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, Maschil.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. A contemplative psalm.

verses.he: אֱלֹהִ֤ים ׀ בְּאָזְנֵ֬ינוּ שָׁמַ֗עְנוּ אֲבֹותֵ֥ינוּ סִפְּרוּ־לָ֑נוּ פֹּ֥עַל פָּעַ֥לְתָּ בִֽ֝ימֵיהֶ֗ם בִּ֣ימֵי קֶֽדֶם׃
verses.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ، بِآذَانِنَا قَدْ سَمِعْنَا. آبَاؤُنَا أَخْبَرُونَا بِعَمَلٍ عَمِلْتَهُ فِي أَيَّامِهِمْ، فِي أَيَّامِ ٱلْقِدَمِ.
verses.en: O God, we have heard with our ears, our fathers have told us; a work Thou didst in their days, in the days of old.
verses.kjv: We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, [what] work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.
verses.web: We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.

verses.he: אַתָּ֤ה ׀ יָדְךָ֡ גֹּויִ֣ם הֹ֭ורַשְׁתָּ וַתִּטָּעֵ֑ם תָּרַ֥ע לְ֝אֻמִּ֗ים וַֽתְּשַׁלְּחֵֽם׃
verses.ar: أَنْتَ بِيَدِكَ ٱسْتَأْصَلْتَ ٱلْأُمَمَ وَغَرَسْتَهُمْ. حَطَّمْتَ شُعُوبًا وَمَدَدْتَهُمْ.
verses.en: Thou with Thy hand didst drive out the nations, and didst plant them in; Thou didst break the peoples, and didst spread them abroad.
verses.kjv: [How] thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; [how] thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.
verses.web: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.

verses.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֪א בְחַרְבָּ֡ם יָ֥רְשׁוּ אָ֗רֶץ וּזְרֹועָם֮ לֹא־הֹושִׁ֪יעָ֫ה לָּ֥מֹו כִּֽי־יְמִֽינְךָ֣ וּ֭זְרֹועֲךָ וְאֹ֥ור פָּנֶ֗יךָ כִּ֣י רְצִיתָֽם׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ لَيْسَ بِسَيْفِهِمْ ٱمْتَلَكُوا ٱلْأَرْضَ، وَلَا ذِرَاعُهُمْ خَلَّصَتْهُمْ، لَكِنْ يَمِينُكَ وَذِرَاعُكَ وَنُورُ وَجْهِكَ، لِأَنَّكَ رَضِيتَ عَنْهُمْ.
verses.en: For not by their own sword did they get the land in possession, neither did their own arm save them; but Thy right hand, and Thine arm, and the light of Thy countenance, because Thou wast favourable unto them.
verses.kjv: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.
verses.web: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.

verses.he: אַתָּה־ה֣וּא מַלְכִּ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים צַ֝וֵּ֗ה יְשׁוּעֹ֥ות יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.ar: أَنْتَ هُوَ مَلِكِي يَا ٱللهُ، فَأْمُرْ بِخَلَاصِ يَعْقُوبَ.
verses.en: Thou art my King, O God; command the salvation of Jacob.
verses.kjv: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.
verses.web: God, you are my King. Command victories for Jacob!

verses.he: בְּ֭ךָ צָרֵ֣ינוּ נְנַגֵּ֑חַ בְּ֝שִׁמְךָ֗ נָב֥וּס קָמֵֽינוּ׃
verses.ar: بِكَ نَنْطَحُ مُضَايِقِينَا. بِٱسْمِكَ نَدُوسُ ٱلْقَائِمِينَ عَلَيْنَا.
verses.en: Through Thee do we push down our adversaries; through Thy name do we tread them under that rise up against us.
verses.kjv: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.
verses.web: Through you, we will push down our adversaries. Through your name, we will tread down those who rise up against us.

verses.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א בְקַשְׁתִּ֣י אֶבְטָ֑ח וְ֝חַרְבִּ֗י לֹ֣א תֹושִׁיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.ar: لِأَنِّي عَلَى قَوْسِي لَا أَتَّكِلُ، وَسَيْفِي لَا يُخَلِّصُنِي.
verses.en: For I trust not in my bow, neither can my sword save me.
verses.kjv: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.
verses.web: For I will not trust in my bow, neither will my sword save me.

verses.he: כִּ֣י הֹ֭ושַׁעְתָּנוּ מִצָּרֵ֑ינוּ וּמְשַׂנְאֵ֥ינוּ הֱבִישֹֽׁותָ׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ خَلَّصْتَنَا مِنْ مُضَايِقِينَا، وَأَخْزَيْتَ مُبْغِضِينَا.
verses.en: But Thou hast saved us from our adversaries, and hast put them to shame that hate us.
verses.kjv: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.
verses.web: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.

verses.he: בֵּֽ֭אלֹהִים הִלַּלְ֣נוּ כָל־הַיֹּ֑ום וְשִׁמְךָ֓ ׀ לְעֹולָ֖ם נֹודֶ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃
verses.ar: بِٱللهِ نَفْتَخِرُ ٱلْيَوْمَ كُلَّهُ، وَٱسْمَكَ نَحْمَدُ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.en: In God have we gloried all the day, and we will give thanks unto Thy name for ever. Selah
verses.kjv: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.
verses.web: In God we have made our boast all day long. We will give thanks to your name forever. Selah.

verses.he: אַף־זָ֭נַחְתָּ וַתַּכְלִימֵ֑נוּ וְלֹא־תֵ֝צֵ֗א בְּצִבְאֹותֵֽינוּ׃
verses.ar: لَكِنَّكَ قَدْ رَفَضْتَنَا وَأَخْجَلْتَنَا، وَلَا تَخْرُجُ مَعَ جُنُودِنَا.
verses.en: Yet Thou hast cast off, and brought us to confusion; and goest not forth with our hosts.
verses.kjv: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.
verses.web: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.

verses.he: תְּשִׁיבֵ֣נוּ אָ֭חֹור מִנִּי־צָ֑ר וּ֝מְשַׂנְאֵ֗ינוּ שָׁ֣סוּ לָֽמֹו׃
verses.ar: تُرْجِعُنَا إِلَى ٱلْوَرَاءِ عَنِ ٱلْعَدُوِّ، وَمُبْغِضُونَا نَهَبُوا لِأَنْفُسِهِمْ.
verses.en: Thou makest us to turn back from the adversary; and they that hate us spoil at their will.
verses.kjv: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.
verses.web: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.

verses.he: תִּ֭תְּנֵנוּ כְּצֹ֣אן מַאֲכָ֑ל וּ֝בַגֹּויִ֗ם זֵרִיתָֽנוּ׃
verses.ar: جَعَلْتَنَا كَٱلضَّأْنِ أُكْلًا. ذَرَّيْتَنَا بَيْنَ ٱلْأُمَمِ.
verses.en: Thou hast given us like sheep to be eaten; and hast scattered us among the nations.
verses.kjv: Thou hast given us like sheep [appointed] for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.
verses.web: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.

verses.he: תִּמְכֹּֽר־עַמְּךָ֥ בְלֹא־הֹ֑ון וְלֹ֥א־רִ֝בִּ֗יתָ בִּמְחִירֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.ar: بِعْتَ شَعْبَكَ بِغَيْرِ مَالٍ، وَمَا رَبِحْتَ بِثَمَنِهِمْ.
verses.en: Thou sellest Thy people for small gain, and hast not set their prices high.
verses.kjv: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase [thy wealth] by their price.
verses.web: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.

verses.he: תְּשִׂימֵ֣נוּ חֶ֭רְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנֵ֑ינוּ לַ֥עַג וָ֝קֶ֗לֶס לִסְבִיבֹותֵֽינוּ׃
verses.ar: تَجْعَلُنَا عَارًا عِنْدَ جِيرَانِنَا، هُزْأَةً وَسُخْرَةً لِلَّذِينَ حَوْلَنَا.
verses.en: Thou makest us a taunt to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.
verses.kjv: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.
verses.web: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.

verses.he: תְּשִׂימֵ֣נוּ מָ֭שָׁל בַּגֹּויִ֑ם מְנֹֽוד־רֹ֝֗אשׁ בַּל־אֻמִּֽים׃
verses.ar: تَجْعَلُنَا مَثَلًا بَيْنَ ٱلشُّعُوبِ. لِإِنْغَاضِ ٱلرَّأْسِ بَيْنَ ٱلْأُمَمِ.
verses.en: Thou makest us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
verses.kjv: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.
verses.web: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.

verses.he: כָּל־הַ֭יֹּום כְּלִמָּתִ֣י נֶגְדִּ֑י וּבֹ֖שֶׁת פָּנַ֣י כִּסָּֽתְנִי׃
verses.ar: ٱلْيَوْمَ كُلَّهُ خَجَلِي أَمَامِي، وَخِزْيُ وَجْهِي قَدْ غَطَّانِي.
verses.en: All the day is my confusion before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,
verses.kjv: My confusion [is] continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,
verses.web: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,

verses.he: מִ֭קֹּול מְחָרֵ֣ף וּמְגַדֵּ֑ף מִפְּנֵ֥י אֹ֝ויֵ֗ב וּמִתְנַקֵּֽם׃
verses.ar: مِنْ صَوْتِ ٱلْمُعَيِّرِ وَٱلشَّاتِمِ. مِنْ وَجْهِ عَدُوٍّ وَمُنْتَقِمٍ.
verses.en: For the voice of him that taunteth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and the revengeful.
verses.kjv: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.
verses.web: at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.

verses.he: כָּל־זֹ֣את בָּ֭אַתְנוּ וְלֹ֣א שְׁכַחֲנ֑וּךָ וְלֹֽא־שִׁ֝קַּ֗רְנוּ בִּבְרִיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.ar: هَذَا كُلُّهُ جَاءَ عَلَيْنَا، وَمَا نَسِينَاكَ وَلَا خُنَّا فِي عَهْدِكَ.
verses.en: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten Thee, neither have we been false to Thy covenant.
verses.kjv: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.
verses.web: All this has come on us, yet we haven’t forgotten you. We haven’t been false to your covenant.

verses.he: לֹא־נָסֹ֣וג אָחֹ֣ור לִבֵּ֑נוּ וַתֵּ֥ט אֲשֻׁרֵ֗ינוּ מִנִּ֥י אָרְחֶֽךָ׃
verses.ar: لَمْ يَرْتَدَّ قَلْبُنَا إِلَى وَرَاءٍ، وَلَا مَالَتْ خَطْوَتُنَا عَنْ طَرِيقِكَ،
verses.en: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from Thy path;
verses.kjv: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;
verses.web: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,

verses.he: כִּ֣י דִ֭כִּיתָנוּ בִּמְקֹ֣ום תַּנִּ֑ים וַתְּכַ֖ס עָלֵ֣ינוּ בְצַלְמָֽוֶת׃
verses.ar: حَتَّى سَحَقْتَنَا فِي مَكَانِ ٱلتَّنَانِينِ، وَغَطَّيْتَنَا بِظِلِّ ٱلْمَوْتِ.
verses.en: Though Thou hast crushed us into a place of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.
verses.kjv: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.
verses.web: though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.

verses.he: אִם־שָׁ֭כַחְנוּ שֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וַנִּפְרֹ֥שׂ כַּ֝פֵּ֗ינוּ לְאֵ֣ל זָֽר׃
verses.ar: إِنْ نَسِينَا ٱسْمَ إِلَهِنَا أَوْ بَسَطْنَا أَيْدِيَنَا إِلَى إِلَهٍ غَرِيبٍ،
verses.en: If we had forgotten the name of our God, or spread forth our hands to a strange god;
verses.kjv: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;
verses.web: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god,

verses.he: הֲלֹ֣א אֱ֭לֹהִים יַֽחֲקָר־זֹ֑את כִּֽי־ה֥וּא יֹ֝דֵ֗עַ תַּעֲלֻמֹ֥ות לֵֽב׃
verses.ar: أَفَلَا يَفْحَصُ ٱللهُ عَنْ هَذَا؟ لِأَنَّهُ هُوَ يَعْرِفُ خَفِيَّاتِ ٱلْقَلْبِ.
verses.en: Would not God search this out? For He knoweth the secrets of the heart.
verses.kjv: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.
verses.web: won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.

verses.he: כִּֽי־עָ֭לֶיךָ הֹרַ֣גְנוּ כָל־הַיֹּ֑ום נֶ֝חְשַׁ֗בְנוּ כְּצֹ֣אן טִבְחָֽה׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّنَا مِنْ أَجْلِكَ نُمَاتُ ٱلْيَوْمَ كُلَّهُ. قَدْ حُسِبْنَا مِثْلَ غَنَمٍ لِلذَّبْحِ.
verses.en: Nay, but for Thy sake are we killed all the day; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.kjv: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.web: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.

verses.he: ע֤וּרָה ׀ לָ֖מָּה תִישַׁ֥ן ׀ אֲדֹנָ֑י הָ֝קִ֗יצָה אַל־תִּזְנַ֥ח לָנֶֽצַח׃
verses.ar: اِسْتَيْقِظْ! لِمَاذَا تَتَغَافَى يَارَبُّ؟ ٱنْتَبِهْ! لَا تَرْفُضْ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ.
verses.en: Awake, why sleepest Thou, O Lord? Arouse Thyself, cast not off for ever.
verses.kjv: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast [us] not off for ever.
verses.web: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.

verses.he: לָֽמָּה־פָנֶ֥יךָ תַסְתִּ֑יר תִּשְׁכַּ֖ח עָנְיֵ֣נוּ וְֽלַחֲצֵֽנוּ׃
verses.ar: لِمَاذَا تَحْجُبُ وَجْهَكَ وَتَنْسَى مَذَلَّتَنَا وَضِيقَنَا؟
verses.en: Wherefore hidest Thou Thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?
verses.kjv: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, [and] forgettest our affliction and our oppression?
verses.web: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?

verses.he: כִּ֤י שָׁ֣חָה לֶעָפָ֣ר נַפְשֵׁ֑נוּ דָּבְקָ֖ה לָאָ֣רֶץ בִּטְנֵֽנוּ׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّ أَنْفُسَنَا مُنْحَنِيَةٌ إِلَى ٱلتُّرَابِ. لَصِقَتْ فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ بُطُونُنَا.
verses.en: For our soul is bowed down to the dust; our belly cleaveth unto the earth.
verses.kjv: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.
verses.web: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.

verses.he: ק֭וּמָֽה עֶזְרָ֣תָה לָּ֑נוּ וּ֝פְדֵ֗נוּ לְמַ֣עַן חַסְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.ar: قُمْ عَوْنًا لَنَا وَٱفْدِنَا مِنْ أَجْلِ رَحْمَتِكَ.
verses.en: Arise for our help, and redeem us for Thy mercy's sake.
verses.kjv: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies’ sake.
verses.web: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.
